name: Guangdong Xinyaguang Cable Co Ltd
summary: Guangdong Xinyaguang Cable Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the innovation, production, and distribution of various wires and cables. Their comprehensive product line features specialized items such as aluminum alloy conductor cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) insulated power cables, overhead insulated cables rated for 1KV and 10KV, and 0.6/1kV XLPE insulated power cables. Additionally, they provide round wire concentric stranded overhead conductors, plastic-insulated control cables, and PVC insulated cables. These diverse solutions are utilized across numerous critical sectors, including electric power infrastructure, rail transit systems, construction projects, new energy initiatives, intelligent manufacturing equipment, and broader power transmission networks. Established in 1999, the company operates from its headquarters located in Qingyuan, China.
